settings.title: Complete checkout
settings.text: Pay for your order. Your download link appears on the confirmation page.

settings.title: Check your email
settings.text: We also email the link to the address you used at checkout.

settings.title: Download the files
settings.text: Open the link and save each file to your device.

settings.title: Open and use
settings.text: Open PDFs in any PDF reader, or print them at home.

settings.heading: I can't find my order email
settings.row_content: Search your inbox for your order number, then check spam, promotions and updates folders. Make sure the email address on your order is correct. Still missing? Contact us with your order number.

settings.heading: The download link doesn't open
settings.row_content: Copy the link and paste it into a different browser, or try another device. Some in-app browsers (for example inside social media apps) block downloads — open the link in Chrome or Safari instead.

settings.heading: The file won't open on my phone
settings.row_content: Install or update a PDF reader, then open the file from your Downloads folder. On iPhone, look in the Files app under Downloads.

settings.heading: The file looks damaged or incomplete
settings.row_content: Delete the file and download it again over a stable connection. If it's still damaged, contact us and we'll send a working copy or refund you as described in our refund policy.

settings.heading: My link has expired
settings.row_content: Contact us with your order number and we'll send you a new link.
